title: Anna and Tom
text:
Anna is my best friend. She is very kind and funny. She always helps people when they have problems.

Her brother, Tom, is different. He is quiet and shy. But he is also very smart, and he likes to read books.

questions.text: What does Tom like to do?
Why does Anna help people when they have problems?
options: She has a lot of money.

questions.text: How is Tom different from Anna?

vocabulary.definition: having a gentle and caring nature
not comfortable talking to other people
able to learn and think quickly

paragraph_translations: Анна — моя найкраща подруга. Вона дуже добра і смішна. Вона завжди допомагає людям, коли в них є проблеми.
Її брат Том інший. Він тихий і сором'язливий. Але він також дуже розумний, і він любить читати книжки.
